children: Apple (AAPL) launched a foldable iPhone Duo with a 7.6" display, shipping Oct. 23. Counterpoint sees ~6M units by year-end; IDC forecasts Apple could hold 40% of foldable market by 2027.
AAPL began shipping iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max with global delivery times about 2–4 weeks, ~15% longer than last year. Pro model production rose ~18% year‑over‑year; component costs increased.
Analyst Gene Munster says iPhone Duo could be ~8% of units next year and ~14% of iPhone revenue, implying higher Duo sales may raise Apple (AAPL) iPhone units and revenue.
AAPL held roughly $147B cash at fiscal Q3 end. Apple rarely makes big deals; most acquisitions are under $1B, with 2014 Beats cited as its largest so far.
Morgan Stanley says AAPL high valuation limits downside, expects new Duo foldable to nearly sell out next 12 months, and forecasts services growth to dip below 10% in the September quarter.
Apple (AAPL) adds a custom Gemini model to Siri for cross‑app actions and multi‑step tasks using messages, emails and photos; feature launched about two years after its initial announcement.
Three investors sued Apple (AAPL) after losing nearly $180M in Bitcoin to fake crypto wallet apps downloaded from the App Store, alleging the apps stole their holdings.
Apple cut a small number of Fitness+ staff tied to audio shows (Time to Walk/Run). Audio releases may slow as Apple rethinks Fitness+ and plans tighter Health app integration.
Investor Jason Calacanis suggested Apple (AAPL) might use cash to fund big acquisitions in AI, media and logistics, naming Disney and on-demand services as possible targets.
